messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a small rollout of the routing-tier change + a few observability tweaks at 11:30 PT today. Canary -> 25% -> 100%. Who can own smoke checks and dashboard updates?

jonah: I can own smoke checks. Will be online at 11:15 PT. What exactly are the dashboard tweaks?

maya: thanks @jonah. Two things: 1) bump trace sampling for this model path from 10% -> 25% so we can catch regression traces during canary; 2) modify the P95 latency panel to show separate lines for canary vs prod (so we can see divergence). Also slightly raise the latency alert threshold for that route from 300ms -> 450ms during the 25% canary window.

lina: pinging on the panel ids — I assume these are panels in /dashboards/llm-serving/routing.json? If so I can change the panel query and add the series split by tag. Will push a tiny PR.

samir: FYI alert change: current `error_rate > 0.2%` -> suggest `0.5%` for canary window only. We should create a temporary override rule rather than editing the core policy. I'll draft the override and tag the on-call.

jonah: plan for smoke checks:
```
- 11:25 PT: run 10 short requests + 5 long requests against canary endpoint
- verify token usage / billing metrics look normal
- check logs for 5xx and spikes in tail latency
- validate example trace shows kv-cache hits
```

jonah: I'll post quick results in this thread. If any of the two criteria fail (error_rate spike OR p95 > 2x baseline) we rollback.

maya: ops-bot says CI is green for the config PR: <https://redwood.dev/pr/4123|pr/4123> :tada:

ops-bot: CI passed — all checks green for PR 4123 (routing-tier + dash tweaks).

lina: PR up: https://redwood.dev/pr/4123 — small grafana query change and added series split. reviewers: @maya @samir

samir: reviewing now, will approve if the override is in place. Also adding a note to the oncall playbook to watch `trace-sample-rate` tag.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy accepted — start at 1674121800 (11:30 PT). Canary 25% at start, auto-promote at 11:50 PT if health checks pass.

maya: sweet. @jonah please run smoke checks at 11:25 and paste results. @lina @samir please make sure your small PRs and overrides are merged by 11:20.

jonah: will do. TL;DR: I'm owner for smoke checks, rollback ready, watching latency & error_rate.

lina: PR merged at 11:18.

samir: override rule created and linked: https://redwood.dev/ops/overrides/88 — expires in 40m.

jonah: smoke check results (11:26): 10 short reqs -> 0 errors; 5 long reqs -> 0 errors; p95 canary 310ms, prod baseline 295ms. No spike in 5xx. KV cache hit rate normal. :white_check_mark:

maya: perfect. going to flip the switch at 11:30. rolling canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion started -> 25% traffic routed.

jonah: monitoring. traces look sensible, can see increased sample rate. Dash looks clean, separate lines showing canary vs prod.

maya: if things stay green for 20m we promote to 100%. Thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for any follow-ups.
